profile_text.body:
Ambarella Inc is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, and trades under the ticker AMBA. According to its own website, it makes AI vision processors for edge applications, and the company describes its imaging solutions as making cameras smarter by extracting data from high-resolution video streams. It also lists automotive uses including advanced driver assistance systems, smart electronic mirrors, drive recorders, and autonomous vehicles.

The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001280263. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it, so its profile rests mainly on its own description of its edge AI vision work and its status as a publicly traded registrant.
